sprites.title: Sprite & Graphics
sprites.description: Design and animate sprites directly in the IDE. Place characters on screen, control movement with BASIC commands, and bring your games to life.

sound.title: Sound & Music
sound.description: Compose chiptune music using MML notation. The PLAY command brings authentic 8-bit sound to your programs.
